scenes.narration: The next night. <short pause> Your friend Sam's on passing duty. <short pause> Chalk's out of goal, chasing. <short pause> Your back's to the goal. You face Sam. The pass comes. <short pause> Stiff foot. It bounces away. You look up. <long pause> Chalk's already there. Ball gone. <short pause> You had the ball for two seconds. It felt like nothing. Where did the time go?

sentences.text: Your friend Sam's on passing duty.
You had the ball for two seconds.

scenes.narration: This ring is your time. <short pause> It counts the seconds until Chalk reaches the ball, if he keeps coming at a jog. <short pause> Sprinting shrinks the numbers, not the fixes. <short pause> When the pass arrived: just over half a second. One heartbeat. <short pause> Remember this ring.

sentences.text: It counts the seconds until Chalk reaches the ball, if he keeps coming at a jog.
Sprinting shrinks the numbers, not the fixes.
When the pass arrived: just over half a second.

scenes.narration: Football isn't only a game of speed. It's a game of time. <short pause> The best players look slow. They bought time before anyone noticed. <short pause> Three ways to buy it. Look. Touch. Shape. <short pause> By lights out: four times the time.

sentences.text: Football isn't only a game of speed.
They bought time before anyone noticed.
By lights out: four times the time.

scenes.chapter: Ch1 Look: what a scan is
scenes.narration: Way one: look. <short pause> Before the ball comes, look over your shoulder. You know this one: a scan. <short pause> A snapshot, not a stare. Click, and back. Your eyes barely stop. <short pause> One question: where's Chalk? <short pause> Pros do it right up to the touch.

sentences.text: Before the ball comes, look over your shoulder.
You know this one: a scan.
Pros do it right up to the touch.

scenes.narration: Why not look after it arrives? <short pause> Noticing something new: about a third of a second. Choosing what to do: about half a second. <short pause> That's two of Chalk's steps. <short pause> Like checking for cars after stepping off the kerb. <short pause> Check first. Then move.

sentences.text: Why not look after it arrives?
Noticing something new: about a third of a second.
Choosing what to do: about half a second.
Like checking for cars after stepping off the kerb.

scenes.chapter: Ch1 Look: two looks, one map
scenes.narration: So look early. <short pause> Ball leaves Sam's foot: look. Halfway: look again. Then eyes on the ball. <short pause> Where's Chalk? Where's the space? They build a map in your head. <short pause> You know what's behind you.

sentences.text: They build a map in your head.

scenes.narration: Elite youth players: one look before the ball? Three times the odds of a good next move. <short pause> Did the look cause it? Nobody's proved that. It went with it. <short pause> Small, but free, dozens of times a game. <short pause> Know early, move early, even one step. <short pause> The ring's there before the ball.

sentences.text: Elite youth players: one look before the ball?
Three times the odds of a good next move.
Small, but free, dozens of times a game.
Know early, move early, even one step.
The ring's there before the ball.

scenes.narration: Classic mistake: eyes glued to the ball. <short pause> Fix: ball leaves the foot, head goes. <short pause> Two coloured cones behind you. Sam passes and calls one. Look back, find it, shout left or right before the ball's halfway. Late call? Doesn't count. <short pause> Slow passes first.

sentences.text: Classic mistake: eyes glued to the ball.
Fix: ball leaves the foot, head goes.
Look back, find it, shout left or right before the ball's halfway.

scenes.narration: Way two: touch. <short pause> Your first touch decides your next second. <short pause> The ball doesn't bounce off just because your boot's hard. Mostly it's the speed gap: fast ball, still foot. Big gap, big bounce. <short pause> Catch an egg with a stiff hand: splat. Move with it: safe.

sentences.text: Your first touch decides your next second.
The ball doesn't bounce off just because your boot's hard.
Mostly it's the speed gap: fast ball, still foot.
Catch an egg with a stiff hand: splat.

scenes.narration: Stiff, still foot: it leaves at maybe a third of its speed. <short pause> Now move your foot back with it. The gap shrinks. The bounce dies. That's a cushion. <short pause> Contact: about a hundredth of a second. Far shorter than a blink. So be soft before it lands.

sentences.text: Stiff, still foot: it leaves at maybe a third of its speed.
Now move your foot back with it.
Contact: about a hundredth of a second.
So be soft before it lands.

scenes.narration: Step one: kill the bounce. With Chalk coming, it buys nothing alone. <short pause> One touch into space, away from Chalk, buys metres. <short pause> At Chalk's jog, every two metres is about half a second. <short pause> Pros: touch, touch, gone. <short pause> Your first touch is the steering wheel.

sentences.text: With Chalk coming, it buys nothing alone.
One touch into space, away from Chalk, buys metres.
At Chalk's jog, every two metres is about half a second.
Your first touch is the steering wheel.

scenes.narration: Classic mistake: killing it dead under your feet. <short pause> Fix: soft foot, aimed where you're going. <short pause> Wall drill, alone. Cushion the return. Then one touch out of a box, away from a cone. Swap feet. <short pause> Start soft. The car park has suffered enough.

sentences.text: Classic mistake: killing it dead under your feet.
Fix: soft foot, aimed where you're going.

scenes.chapter: Ch3 Shape: half a circle of sight
scenes.narration: Way three: shape. How you stand. <short pause> Arms out wide. You see everything between your hands. A bit more than a half circle. <short pause> Sharp only in a thumbnail-sized spot at arm's length. <short pause> The rest: blur. It catches movement, not whose shirt.

sentences.text: You see everything between your hands.
A bit more than a half circle.
Sharp only in a thumbnail-sized spot at arm's length.
It catches movement, not whose shirt.

scenes.chapter: Ch3 Shape: straight on costs a turn
scenes.narration: Face Sam straight on. Goal behind you. Chalk lives there. <short pause> To play forward, you turn. A full turn costs over half a second. Timed on youth players running and turning, no ball. <short pause> That's your whole ring from the first pass.

sentences.text: A full turn costs over half a second.
Timed on youth players running and turning, no ball.
That's your whole ring from the first pass.

scenes.narration: Now stand side-on. The half-turn. Old cue, new reason. <short pause> Sam in the corner of one eye, the goal in the other. <short pause> The corner of your eye catches movement. The look tells you who. <short pause> Every look is now a small turn.

sentences.text: Sam in the corner of one eye, the goal in the other.
The corner of your eye catches movement.
Every look is now a small turn.

scenes.narration: Take it on your back foot, the one further from Sam. Toes where you're going. <short pause> It rolls across you, train through a station. <short pause> Half-turned, back foot: no turn to pay for. You play forward while the ring's still big.

sentences.text: Take it on your back foot, the one further from Sam.
It rolls across you, train through a station.
Half-turned, back foot: no turn to pay for.
You play forward while the ring's still big.

scenes.narration: Classic mistake: facing the passer with room to turn. <short pause> Fix: side-on, before the pass. <short pause> Two gates behind you. Sam calls a gate, then passes. Open to that gate. Back foot, one touch through it, pass back. <short pause> Easy passes first.

sentences.text: Classic mistake: facing the passer with room to turn.
Sam calls a gate, then passes.
Back foot, one touch through it, pass back.

scenes.narration: One more way: steal time. <short pause> Shoulders one way, ball the other. <short pause> One test, adult players: a fake cost the defender about half a second. Two of Chalk's steps, stolen. <short pause> But that's for another night.

sentences.text: Shoulders one way, ball the other.
One test, adult players: a fake cost the defender about half a second.

scenes.narration: The first pass again. <short pause> It leaves Sam's foot: look. Chalk, about ten metres out, jogging in. <short pause> Don't wait. Go to the ball, opening side-on. <short pause> Halfway: look again. Still far.

sentences.text: Chalk, about ten metres out, jogging in.
Go to the ball, opening side-on.

scenes.narration: Back foot. It rolls across you. <short pause> Soft touch, into space. Away from Chalk. <short pause> Read the ring. Almost two and a half seconds. <long pause> Chalk arrives. <short pause> To nothing.

sentences.text: Almost two and a half seconds.

scenes.narration: Same legs. Same speed. Four times the time. <short pause> You looked earlier, moved earlier, and met the ball side-on. Then one touch where Chalk wasn't. <short pause> That's why the best players look slow.

sentences.text: You looked earlier, moved earlier, and met the ball side-on.
Then one touch where Chalk wasn't.
That's why the best players look slow.

scenes.narration: Where did the time go? <short pause> Nowhere. You bought it before anyone noticed. <short pause> Lights out. <short pause> Next pass that rolls at you: take a snapshot.
